outcome: Admission to the intensive care unit (ICU)
cohort: The study included 1,423,099 linked maternal and live newborn records from women with a delivery diagnosis in the U.S. between 2010 and 2014.
finding: Maternal OSA was associated with a higher risk of congenital anomalies (aOR 1.26), particularly musculoskeletal anomalies (aOR 1.89), and increased odds of neonatal ICU admission, resuscitation (aOR 2.76), and longer hospital stays (aOR 2.25).
followup_time: At birth and during initial hospital stay
